info.name: GitHub Check if Pull Request Has Been Merged

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pull_number
params.description: The number that identifies the pull request.

items.docs: Checks if a pull request has been merged into the base branch. The HTTP status of the response indicates whether or not the pull request has been merged; the response body is empty.
